# CandidateRow Sheet Refactor - Complete API Analysis

## 1. Sheet Component API (src/components/ui/sheet.tsx)

### Core Components & Props:
- **Sheet** - Root component (Radix Dialog primitive wrapper)
- **SheetTrigger** - Trigger element to open the sheet
- **SheetContent** - Main container with `side` prop
  - **side prop options**: `"top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"` (default: `"right"`)
  - Supports custom className
  - Auto-includes close button (X) at top-right
  - Portal structure with overlay
- **SheetHeader** - Flex container for top section, has space-y-2
- **SheetTitle** - Title element, styled as lg font-semibold
- **SheetDescription** - Optional description below title
- **SheetFooter** - Footer section, flex-col-reverse on mobile
- **SheetOverlay** - Dark overlay (bg-black/80) behind sheet
- **SheetPortal** - Radix Portal wrapper
- **SheetClose** - Explicit close button component

### Key Features:
- Uses Radix UI dialog primitives
- CSS animations (slide-in/slide-out)
- Default z-50 stacking
- Responsive width (sm:max-w-sm for left/right)
- Built-in close button with X icon
- Smooth 500ms open / 300ms close animations

---

## 2. CandidateRow Component (src/components/CandidateRow.tsx)

### Props Interface:
```typescript
interface CandidateRowProps {
  result: Result;
  index: number;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  isSelected: boolean;
  jobTitle?: string | null;
  onToggleRow: (id: string) => void;
  onToggleSelect: (resumeId: string) => void;
  onDownload: (filePath: string, filename: string) => void;
  onDelete: (resumeId: string, filePath: string | null) => void;
  onDismiss: (resumeId: string) => void;
  formatCandidateName: (filename: string) => string;
  currentStage?: HiringStage | null;
  stageUpdatedAt?: string | null;
  onStageChange?: (resumeId: string, stage: HiringStage) => void;
  onRewriteJd?: () => void;
  isDuplicate?: boolean;
}
```

### Current Implementation Structure:

#### Collapsed Row (TableRow):
- Checkbox column (selection toggle)
- Rank display (top 3 have special badges)
- Name + Location (with duplicate/stage badges)
- Overall score with progress bar
- Strength badge + scoring version badges
- Action buttons (phone, email, download, archive, expand chevron)
- All in TableCell elements
- Row is clickable to expand (onClick delegates to onToggleRow)
- Click handlers stop propagation where needed

#### Expanded Detail (CollapsibleContent -> TableCell):
Structure within the collapsed TableRow:
- **Summary + Stage Section**
  - CandidateSummary (if summary exists)
  - StageTracker (if onStageChange provided)
  - Separated by border-t

- **Strengths & Gaps Panel**
  - StrengthsGapsPanel component

- **3-Column Grid** (md:grid-cols-3):
  - SkillsDetailPanel
  - ExperiencePanel (receives matched_must_haves, parsed_json)
  - EducationPanel (receives parsed_json, matched/missing must_haves)

- **JD Alignment**
  - JDAlignedPanel

- **Interview Questions**
  - InterviewQuestionsPanel

- **EmailOutreachDialog**
  - Separate component rendered outside Collapsible
  - Controlled by emailDialogOpen state
  - Only renders if candidate has email

### Current UI Pattern:
- Uses Collapsible + CollapsibleContent from @/components/ui/collapsible
- Expanded detail row has bg-muted/30 hover:bg-muted/30
- Detail content wrapped in space-y-5 container
- ColSpan={6} to span all table columns
- Animations applied (fade-in, slide-in-from-bottom)
- Uses inline expansion within table structure

---

## 3. JobDetailView State & Handler (src/components/JobDetailView.tsx)

### State Management:
```typescript
// Line 75
const [expandedRows, setExpandedRows] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

// Line 110
const stageMap = new Map((stages ?? []).map((s) => [s.resume_id, s]));
```

### Handler Functions:
```typescript
// Line 219-221
const toggleRow = (id: string) => {
  setExpandedRows((prev) => { 
    const next = new Set(prev); 
    if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); 
    else next.add(id); 
    return next; 
  });
};

// Line 112-121
const handleStageChange = (resumeId: string, newStage: HiringStage) => {
  if (!selectedJobId) return;
  const current = stageMap.get(resumeId);
  updateStageMutation.mutate({
    resumeId,
    jobId: selectedJobId,
    newStage,
    currentStage: current?.stage,
  });
};
```

### Other Relevant State/Handlers Passed to CandidateRow:
- selectedResumes: Set<string>
- toggleSelectResume(resumeId): toggle selection
- downloadResume(filePath, filename): download handler
- handleDismiss(resumeId): archive handler
- formatCandidateName(filename): format helper
- stageMap.get(r.resume_id)?: returns {stage, updated_at}
- handleStageChange(resumeId, stage): stage update handler
- onRewriteJd: () => void (JD rewrite trigger)

### Reset on Job Change:
Line 276 shows expandedRows is reset to empty Set when job changes:
```typescript
setExpandedRows(new Set());
```

### CandidateRow Rendering:
Lines 1340-1360 show how CandidateRow is rendered with all props passed from JobDetailView

---

## 4. ScrollArea Component (src/components/ui/scroll-area.tsx)

### Components:
- **ScrollArea** - Root container with overflow handling
  - Applies relative overflow-hidden
  - Children wrapped in ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport
- **ScrollBar** - Custom scrollbar (orientation: vertical | horizontal)
  - Default vertical
  - Styled with custom colors (bg-border)
  - Height/width 2.5 based on orientation

### Usage:
- Available for wrapping scrollable content in the sheet
- Can be used to make sheet content scrollable if it exceeds viewport

---

## 5. Refactor Plan Overview

### Key Differences (Table Row → Sheet):
1. **Toggle Mechanism**
   - Current: Collapsible component manages open state
   - New: Sheet component manages open state, still use expandedRows Set

2. **Trigger Element**
   - Current: Entire row is clickable + chevron button in last cell
   - New: Only chevron button acts as SheetTrigger

3. **Detail Content Location**
   - Current: Inline expanded TableRow (sibling to collapsed row)
   - New: Sheet drawer panel on right side (z-50 overlay)

4. **State Management**
   - expandedRows: Set<string> remains unchanged
   - toggleRow(id): function remains same, just controls sheet open instead of collapsible

5. **Content Layout**
   - Current: space-y-5 inside single TableCell
   - New: SheetContent with SheetHeader, ScrollArea for content, optional SheetFooter

6. **Component Integration**
   - All sub-panels (Summary, Skills, Experience, etc.) move into SheetContent
   - EmailOutreachDialog remains external
   - Close button built-in to SheetContent

### Implementation Steps Preview:
1. Convert Collapsible wrapper to Sheet wrapper
2. Move collapsed TableRow content to remains as-is (minus collapsible-specific logic)
3. Create SheetTrigger for chevron button only
4. Wrap expanded content in SheetContent with SheetHeader, SheetTitle
5. Use ScrollArea to wrap detail panels for scroll handling
6. Adjust toggle logic to open/close sheet state
7. Style sheet panel appropriately for candidate details

## Complete API & Structure Analysis for CandidateRow Sheet Refactor

I've thoroughly explored all the requested files and compiled the complete analysis. Here's what you need to know:

### **1. Sheet Component API** (/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx)

**Exports:**
- `Sheet` - Root component (Radix Dialog)
- `SheetTrigger` - Opens the sheet
- `SheetContent` - Main panel container
  - **`side` prop**: `"right"` (default), `"left"`, `"top"`, `"bottom"`
  - Auto-closes with X button at top-right
  - Portal-based (overlays page)
  - Smooth animations: 500ms open / 300ms close
  - Responsive: `sm:max-w-sm` for left/right
- `SheetHeader` - Top section (flex, space-y-2)
- `SheetTitle` - Title text (lg, font-semibold)
- `SheetDescription` - Subtitle (sm text)
- `SheetFooter` - Bottom section
- `SheetOverlay` - Dark bg-black/80 overlay
- `SheetClose` - Manual close button component
- `SheetPortal` - Portal wrapper

---

### **2. CandidateRow Component** (/src/components/CandidateRow.tsx - Full File Read)

**Props:**
```typescript
interface CandidateRowProps {
  result: Result;                    // Candidate data
  index: number;                     // Rank position
  isExpanded: boolean;               // Controlled by parent
  isSelected: boolean;               // Checkbox state
  jobTitle?: string | null;
  onToggleRow: (id: string) => void; // Expansion toggle
  onToggleSelect: (resumeId: string) => void;
  onDownload: (filePath: string, filename: string) => void;
  onDelete: (resumeId: string, filePath: string | null) => void;
  onDismiss: (resumeId: string) => void;
  formatCandidateName: (filename: string) => string;
  currentStage?: HiringStage | null;
  stageUpdatedAt?: string | null;
  onStageChange?: (resumeId: string, stage: HiringStage) => void;
  onRewriteJd?: () => void;
  isDuplicate?: boolean;
}
```

**Collapsed Row Structure (TableRow):**
- Column 1: Checkbox (clickPropagation: stop)
- Column 2: Rank badge (top 3 special, others generic)
- Column 3: Name + Location (with duplicate/stage badges)
- Column 4: Overall score (progress bar + %)
- Column 5: Strength + scoring version badges
- Column 6: Action buttons
  - Phone (copy on desktop)
  - Email (opens EmailOutreachDialog)
  - Download
  - Archive
  - Expand chevron (CollapsibleTrigger)

**Expanded Content (CollapsibleContent wrapping TableRow):**
- **Summary + Stage** (conditional sections)
  - `CandidateSummary` if summary exists
  - `StageTracker` if `onStageChange` provided
  - Separated by `border-t`

- **Strengths & Gaps Panel** (`StrengthsGapsPanel`)

- **3-Column Grid** (md:grid-cols-3):
  - `SkillsDetailPanel`
  - `ExperiencePanel` (matched_must_haves, parsed_json)
  - `EducationPanel` (parsed_json, matched/missing_must_haves)

- **JD Alignment** (`JDAlignedPanel`)

- **Interview Questions** (`InterviewQuestionsPanel`)

**Current Pattern:**
- Uses `Collapsible` + `CollapsibleContent`
- Expanded row: `bg-muted/30` with `colSpan={6}`
- Content in `space-y-5` container
- Click handler on row: `onClick={() => !r.pending && onToggleRow(r.id)}`
- Chevron updates based on `isExpanded` prop

**External Dialog:**
- `EmailOutreachDialog` rendered outside Collapsible
- Controlled by local `emailDialogOpen` state
- Only renders if `r.candidate_email` exists

---

### **3. JobDetailView State Management** (/src/components/JobDetailView.tsx - Line Analysis)

**State:**
```typescript
// Line 75
const [expandedRows, setExpandedRows] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

// Line 107-110
const { data: stages } = useStages(selectedJobId);
const stageMap = new Map((stages ?? []).map((s) => [s.resume_id, s]));
```

**Toggle Function (Line 219-221):**
```typescript
const toggleRow = (id: string) => {
  setExpandedRows((prev) => { 
    const next = new Set(prev); 
    if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); 
    else next.add(id); 
    return next; 
  });
};
```

**Stage Change (Line 112-121):**
```typescript
const handleStageChange = (resumeId: string, newStage: HiringStage) => {
  if (!selectedJobId) return;
  const current = stageMap.get(resumeId);
  updateStageMutation.mutate({
    resumeId,
    jobId: selectedJobId,
    newStage,
    currentStage: current?.stage,
  });
};
```

**CandidateRow Props (Lines 1340-1360):**
```typescript
<CandidateRow
  key={r.id}
  result={r}
  index={index}
  isExpanded={expandedRows.has(r.id)}              // Set check
  isSelected={selectedResumes.has(r.resume_id)}
  jobTitle={selectedJob?.title}
  onToggleRow={toggleRow}
  onToggleSelect={toggleSelectResume}
  onDownload={downloadResume}
  onDelete={(resumeId, filePath) => setDeleteConfirm({ type: "single", resumeId, filePath })}
  onDismiss={handleDismiss}
  formatCandidateName={formatCandidateName}
  currentStage={stageMap.get(r.resume_id)?.stage}           // From API
  stageUpdatedAt={stageMap.get(r.resume_id)?.updated_at}
  onStageChange={handleStageChange}
  onRewriteJd={() => setJdRewriteOpen(true)}
  isDuplicate={duplicateResumeIds.has(r.resume_id)}
/>
```

**Reset on Job Switch (Line 276):**
```typescript
setExpandedRows(new Set());  // Clear all expansions
```

---

### **4. ScrollArea Component** (/src/components/ui/scroll-area.tsx)

**Exports:**
- `ScrollArea` - Root container
  - Wraps children in `ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport`
  - Applies `overflow-hidden`
- `ScrollBar` - Vertical or horizontal
  - `orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal"`
  - Styled thumb (bg-border, rounded-full)

**Usage:** Wraps content for custom scroll behavior

---

### **Key Refactor Insights**

| Aspect | Current | New (Sheet) |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| **Component** | Collapsible + CollapsibleContent | Sheet + SheetContent |
| **Location** | Inline table row (sibling below) | Right-side drawer overlay |
| **State** | `expandedRows: Set<string>` | Same (controls sheet open) |
| **Trigger** | Row click + chevron button | Chevron button only (SheetTrigger) |
| **Layout** | TableRow with colSpan={6} | SheetHeader + ScrollArea + content |
| **Close** | Collapsible open prop | Built-in sheet close button |
| **Width** | Full table width | sm:max-w-sm (responsive) |
| **Overlay** | None (inline) | bg-black/80 (z-50) |

---

### **Implementation Blueprint**

```typescript
// From Collapsible:
<Collapsible open={isExpanded} onOpenChange={() => onToggleRow(r.id)} asChild>
  <TableRow>...</TableRow>
  <CollapsibleContent>...</CollapsibleContent>
</Collapsible>

// To Sheet:
<Sheet open={isExpanded} onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open) onToggleRow(r.id); }}>
  <TableRow>
    {/* Collapsed content same */}
    {/* Chevron becomes SheetTrigger */}
  </TableRow>
  <SheetContent side="right">
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>{candidateName}</SheetTitle>
    </SheetHeader>
    <ScrollArea className="h-full">
      {/* All detail panels */}
    </ScrollArea>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
```
